title: Quality Leisure Time and Youth Development
title_primary: Quality Leisure Time and Youth Development
authors: Aderonke Osikominu, Benjamin Fuchs, Francesco Agostinelli, Matthias Doepke, Giuseppe Sorrenti 等
official: 官方在线 2016-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper first develops a simple model to clarify the links between leisure time use and skill formation. It then explores empirically how youths allocate their time. We focus on sports as a popular activity and estimate its effect on behavioral and economic outcomes. We exploit data from the German Socio-Economic Panel that offers the unique advantage of both a large, representative sample and high quality behavioral measures. We employ a flexible strategy combining propensity score matching and regression to account for self selection. Our results suggest that structured leisure activities like sports contribute to the development of nonacademic skills.

official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Industrial policy is back on the agenda across advanced economies, with a growing channelling support towards large incumbent firms on the premise that they are the most capable innovators. This column uses data on French manufacturing firms to argue that this premise deserves scrutiny. Firms become large primarily through occasional, large 'innovation bursts' rather than by innovating at persistently higher rates. The arrival of these bursts involves an element of chance, so a firm's current size says little about how much it will innovate in the future. Policies that entrench the position of incumbents may therefore slow down the churn that sustains aggregate growth.

title: Politics-driven Market Access and Its Cost: Evidence from China’s Grand Canal
title_zh: 政治驱动的市场准入及其成本：来自中国大运河的证据
title_primary: 政治驱动的市场准入及其成本：来自中国大运河的证据

authors: Ying Bai, Xiaoyu Bian, Ruixue Jia
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Transportation networks often radiate from national capitals, reflecting political priorities as much as economic logic. How costly is infrastructure built for politics rather than markets? We study China’s Grand Canal: when the Mongols moved the capital from the central plain to Beijing, the canal followed, bypassing the economic core it once served. Using a grid-year panel spanning five dynasties (8th–19th centuries), we show the route best suited to reach the capital predicts the canal’s actual path. This redesign reshaped market access and, through it, population. Counterfactual analysis shows the canal raised population by 2.5–6.1%, but its politically motivated redesign cost 1.1–2.2%.

title: Green finance and green entrepreneurial entry intensity in China: the role of industrial legacy and science and education endowments

abstract: Green finance is an important policy tool for advancing green development in China, while new green-firm entry is an integral part of this transition. Using data from 278 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2015 to 2023, this study measures the level of green finance development and examines its relationship with green entrepreneurial entry intensity. The empirical results show that green finance is significantly associated with higher green entrepreneurial entry intensity, and this finding remains robust across a series of robustness checks. The mechanism analysis suggests that green technological innovation and the external financing environment are two important channels linking green finance to green entrepreneurial entry. The heterogeneity analysis shows that this positive relationship is stronger in old industrial-base cities and in cities with stronger science and education endowments. The positive relationship also remains robust after accounting for spatial dependence across cities. This study provides empirical evidence on the role of green finance in new green-firm entry and offers useful implications for local governments seeking to develop more targeted green finance and entrepreneurship policies. abstract_zh: 绿色金融是推动中国绿色发展的重要政策工具，而新绿色企业的进入则是这一转型过程中不可或缺的组成部分。本研究利用2015年至2023年中国278个地级市的数据，测度了绿色金融发展水平，并考察了其与绿色创业进入强度之间的关系。实证结果表明，绿色金融与更高的绿色创业进入强度显著相关，且这一发现在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，绿色技术创新和外部融资环境是连接绿色金融与绿色创业进入的两个重要渠道。异质性分析显示，这一正向关系在旧工业基地城市以及科教资源较为丰富的城市中更为显著。在考虑城市间空间依赖性后，这一正向关系依然稳健。本研究为绿色金融在促进新绿色企业进入方面的作用提供了经验证据，并为地方政府制定更具针对性的绿色金融与创业政策提供了有益启示。关键词：绿色金融；绿色创业进入强度；绿色技术创新；工业遗产；科教资源；JEL分类：G21 Q56 L26

title: Beyond coordination: responsibility and the crisis of global food governance design
title_zh: 超越协调：责任与全球粮食治理设计的危机
title_primary: 超越协调：责任与全球粮食治理设计的危机
title_secondary: Beyond coordination: responsibility and the crisis of global food governance design
authors: Michael Carolan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Global food governance is increasingly described as being in crisis, as multilateral cooperation weakens amid rising nationalist and populist politics. However, less attention has been paid to how dominant multilateral modes of governance within the broader field of global governance shape the political conditions in which such tensions emerge. This paper examines how contemporary global food governance is organized primarily around coordination as a governing grammar—a mode of governing oriented toward aligning action across fragmented authority. Drawing on an interpretive analysis of a purposively selected body of authoritative global food governance documents produced between 2012 and 2025, the paper examines how coordination structures action, responsibility, evaluation, and contestation across multilateral institutions. The analysis identifies recurring patterns through which coordination diffuses responsibility, manages failure procedurally, and reframes distributive trade-offs as technical problems, enabling sustained engagement and institutional durability in the absence of centralized authority. These features constrain multilateral institutions’ capacity to assume responsibility, adjudicate conflicts, or respond politically to uneven consequences. Grievances associated with food system transformation often struggle to gain traction within multilateral arenas; this may contribute to their articulation in other political contexts, including national and subnational arenas where responsibility is more readily attributed. Rather than treating such mobilizations as external threats to multilateralism, these dynamics are interpreted as being consistent with the institutional features of coordination-based governance. The paper concludes by outlining implications for global food governance, emphasizing the need to complement coordination with institutional arrangements that clarify responsibility, link measurement to material response, and enable political contestation over distributive trade-offs.
abstract_zh: 全球粮食治理日益被描述为处于危机之中，因为在民族主义和民粹主义政治崛起的背景下，多边合作趋于弱化。然而，对于更广泛的全球治理领域中占主导地位的多边治理模式如何塑造此类紧张关系浮现的政治条件，关注尚显不足。本文考察当代全球粮食治理如何主要围绕“协调”这一治理语法加以组织——这是一种旨在跨碎片化权威对齐行动的治理模式。基于对2012年至2025年间有目的选取的权威全球粮食治理文件进行的解释性分析，本文考察协调如何跨多边机构构建行动、责任、评估与争议。分析识别出反复出现的模式，通过这些模式，协调分散责任、以程序化方式管理失败，并将分配性权衡重新框定为技术性问题，从而在缺乏中央权威的情况下实现持续参与和制度韧性。这些特征制约了多边机构承担责任、裁决冲突或对不均衡后果作出政治回应的能力。与粮食体系转型相关的不满往往难以在多边舞台上获得关注；这可能促使其在其他政治场域中得到表达，包括责任更易被归因的国家和次国家层面。与其将此类动员视为对多边主义的外部威胁，这些动态被解释为与基于协调的治理的制度特征相一致。本文最后概述了对全球粮食治理的启示，强调有必要以明确责任、将测量与实质性回应相挂钩，并允许对分配性权衡进行政治争议的制度安排来补充协调机制。

abstract: We investigate equity price reactions to these two events, which represent major realizations of climate policy transition risk. Our results highlight the heterogeneous nature of climate policy risk exposure. We find sizable reactions that differ by industry as well as across firm-level measures of greenness such as environmental scores and emission intensities. While the financial market response to the IRA was economically significant, it did not lead to instability or financial stress, suggesting that transition risks posed by climate policies even as ambitious as the IRA may be manageable.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了这两个事件对股票价格的反应，它们代表了气候政策转型风险的主要实现形式。我们的结果凸显了气候政策风险暴露的异质性特征。我们发现，不同行业以及企业层面的绿色程度指标（如环境评分和排放强度）之间存在显著的反应差异。尽管金融市场对《通胀削减法案》的反应在经济上意义重大，但并未引发不稳定或金融压力，这表明即使像IRA这样雄心勃勃的气候政策所带来的转型风险也可能是可控的。

abstract: Predictions of the effects of AI on the economy and society tend to focus on productivity growth, job losses, and shifts in the distribution of income. This column examines various potential scenarios for the macroeconomic effects of AI, using Congressional Budget Office projections to estimate their effects on the US federal budget, and discusses their implications for US fiscal policy. The conclusions show that the fiscal consequences of AI will depend not only on how much it raises national income, but also on who receives that income and how policymakers respond.
abstract_zh: 关于人工智能对经济和社会影响的预测，通常聚焦于生产率增长、就业损失以及收入分配的变化。本文利用国会预算办公室的预测，考察了人工智能对宏观经济影响的各种潜在情景，以估算其对美国联邦预算的影响，并探讨了这些影响对美国财政政策的启示。结论表明，人工智能的财政后果不仅取决于其提高国民收入的程度，还取决于谁获得这些收入以及政策制定者如何应对。

title: Tariff Pass-Through and Import Reallocation
title_zh: 关税传导与进口再配置
title_primary: 关税传导与进口再配置
title_secondary: Tariff Pass-Through and Import Reallocation
authors: Mr. JaeBin Ahn & Lorenzo Rotunno & Michele Ruta
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how U.S. tariff hikes in 2025 have transmitted to import prices. Consistent with recent evidence, we find that duty-exclusive import prices at the variety (country-product) level do not adjust to tariffs, implying full pass-through to duty-inclusive prices at the border. At the product level, however, duty-exclusive aggregate import prices decline significantly with tariff increases. We show that this product-level decline is driven by within-product reallocation toward lower-priced sources—stronger in products facing larger tariff hikes—and operates primarily through the entry of lower-priced varieties and the exit of higher-priced ones. Estimates of variety appeal indicate that part of this reallocation reflects shifts toward lower-quality varieties, a channel that is also present in the 2018–19 U.S.–China tariff episode. These reallocation effects carry implications for consumer welfare and productivity through the quality of imported goods and inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2025年美国关税上调如何传导至进口价格。与近期证据一致，我们发现品种（国家-产品）层面的不含税进口价格并未随关税调整，这意味着关税完全传导至边境含税价格。然而在产品层面，不含税的总进口价格却随关税上升而显著下降。研究表明，这种产品层面的价格下降源于同一产品内部向低价来源的重新配置——在面临更大关税上调的产品中更为显著——主要通过低价品种的进入和高价品种的退出实现。品种吸引力估算表明，这种重新配置部分反映了向低质量品种的转移，这一渠道在2018-19年中美关税事件中同样存在。这些重新配置效应通过进口商品和投入品的质量渠道对消费者福利与生产率产生影响。

authors: Enea Baselgia, Isabel Z. Martínez
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present a new data set we built based on Swiss rich lists going back to 1989. We show, among other things, that 60% of the super-rich are heirs—a fraction twice as large as in the United States—and that wealth mobility at the very top has declined significantly. We find that top 0.01% wealth shares are higher than what previous estimates based on wealth tax statistics suggest. At the same time, we argue that rich list data lead to overestimating wealth inequality. Although rich lists are valuable to study the super-rich, we recommend using reported wealth figures with caution.
abstract_zh: 我们基于1989年以来的瑞士富豪榜单构建了一个全新数据集。研究发现，60%的超级富豪为继承财富者——这一比例是美国的两倍——且顶层财富流动性显著下降。我们发现，最富有的0.01%人群的财富份额高于此前基于财富税统计数据的估算结果。同时，我们认为富豪榜单数据会导致财富不平等程度被高估。尽管富豪榜单对研究超级富豪群体具有重要价值，但我们建议谨慎使用所报告的财富数据。

abstract: Central banks are rethinking reserve portfolios as geopolitical fragmentation raises concerns about the accessibility of foreign-held assets, while dollar-funding stress keeps the US dollar at the centre of global financial stability. Using high-frequency US monetary policy surprises and minute-level exchange rates for 18 economies, this column shows that dollar and gold reserves are associated with smaller currency depreciations, especially where official dollar-liquidity backstops are absent and dollar liabilities are large. The findings highlight the importance of maintaining liquidity in the currencies where stress is likely, alongside sound domestic funding structures, credible policy frameworks, and prudent limits on unhedged foreign currency debt.
abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治碎片化加剧，各国央行对境外持有资产的可及性产生担忧，而美元融资压力则使美元始终处于全球金融稳定的核心位置。本文利用高频美国货币政策冲击数据及18个经济体的分钟级汇率数据，发现美元与黄金储备与较小的货币贬值幅度相关，尤其在缺乏官方美元流动性支持且美元负债规模较大的经济体中更为显著。研究结果强调，在维持可能承压货币流动性的同时，还需构建稳健的国内融资结构、可信的政策框架，并对未对冲外币债务设置审慎限额。

title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
title_zh: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性
title_primary: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性
title_secondary: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Maxime Menuet, Gregory Donnat
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们表明：基本盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政响应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释：在该框架中，债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更多取决于融资机制及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。

title: From Training to Self-Employment: Evidence from Youth Agricultural Programmes in Cameroon and Madagascar

official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Youth employment remains a critical issue in Sub-Saharan Africa. This study examines the impact of two large-scale governmental programmes in Cameroon and Madagascar that aim to promote self-employment in agriculture. Youth participated in vocational training and received technical support, inputs and mentoring to engage in crop, livestock or non-farming agricultural activities. We employ a quasi-experimental design to estimate the impact on the income of youth-led activities, and we address the limitations associated with such designs by carefully constructing a counterfactual. Our findings indicate that these integrated training and livelihoods programmes significantly enhance income from the targeted activities. We highlight the importance of providing regular support for participants during and after programme implementation.
abstract_zh: 青年就业仍是撒哈拉以南非洲地区的关键问题。本研究考察了喀麦隆和马达加斯加两项旨在促进农业领域自主创业的大型政府项目的影响。青年参与职业培训，并获得技术支持、物资投入和指导，从事作物种植、畜牧养殖或非耕作类农业活动。我们采用准实验设计来评估这些项目对青年主导活动收入的影响，并通过谨慎构建反事实框架来应对此类设计固有的局限性。研究结果表明，这些综合性的培训与生计项目显著提升了目标活动的收入水平。我们强调在项目实施期间及结束后为参与者提供持续支持的重要性。

abstract: Parents may invest differently across children by compensating the disadvantaged child or by reinforcing the child with higher expected returns. We study this question using a conditional cash transfer experiment that uniquely randomized transfers at the student level, generating exogenous variation in transfer exposure across siblings within the same household. The transfers increased short-run attendance among treated students but generated negative spillovers on untreated siblings: untreated siblings of treated students were 3.7 percentage points less likely to graduate from college, a decline of about 30 percent relative to the control mean. We interpret these effects using a dynamic model of household schooling decisions that identifies parental aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes. The estimated model implies limited aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes and reproduces held-out treatment effects not used in estimation. A decomposition shows that the negative spillover is primarily driven by substitution in educational investments toward the treated child.
abstract_zh: 父母可能会通过补偿处于劣势的孩子或强化预期回报更高的孩子，在不同子女间进行差异化投资。我们利用一项在个体学生层面随机分配转移支付的现金转移实验来研究这一问题，该实验在同一家庭内的兄弟姐妹间产生了外生的转移支付暴露差异。转移支付提高了受助学生的短期出勤率，但对未受助的兄弟姐妹产生了负面溢出效应：受助学生的未受助兄弟姐妹大学毕业的可能性降低了3.7个百分点，相对于对照组均值下降了约30%。我们通过一个家庭学校教育决策的动态模型来解释这些效应，该模型识别出父母对子女教育成果不平等的规避程度。估计模型表明，父母对子女教育成果不平等的规避程度有限，并复现了未用于估计的保留样本中的处理效应。分解分析显示，负面溢出效应主要由教育投资向受助子女的替代效应驱动。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Richard Musgrave et al.’s “Distribution of Tax Payments by Income Groups” (1951) provided the first postwar estimates of the distribution of the fiscal burden, concluding the tax system was not as progressive as statutory rates suggested. Drawing from original archival material, we reconstruct the intellectual context of Musgrave’s study, the methodological debates it gave rise to, and assess its legacy in public finance. The study’s legacy is examined through the rise of econometric estimation, applied general equilibrium modeling, and microdata-based approaches, as well as its influence on policy institutions in the USA and abroad. Despite major advances in data and modeling, we argue that key issues raised by Musgrave—particularly the definition of the income basis and the incidence of the corporate income tax—remain unresolved. The enduring lack of consensus on a uniquely best method highlights both the empirical and normative challenges at the heart of distributional analysis and explains the study’s continued relevance in contemporary debates on taxation and income inequality.
abstract_zh: 理查德·马斯格雷夫等人于1951年发表的《按收入群体划分的税收负担分配》提供了战后首批财政负担分配估算，结论表明税收制度并未如法定税率所示那般具有累进性。基于原始档案材料，我们重构了马斯格雷夫研究的学术背景、由此引发的方法论争论，并评估了其在公共财政领域的学术遗产。通过计量经济学估计、应用一般均衡建模、基于微观数据的方法的兴起，以及该研究对美国及海外政策机构的影响，我们审视了其学术遗产。尽管数据与建模技术取得重大进展，我们认为马斯格雷夫提出的关键问题——特别是收入基础的定义与企业所得税的归宿——仍未得到解决。对唯一最优方法长期缺乏共识，凸显了分配分析核心的经验与规范挑战，也解释了该研究在当代税收与收入不平等辩论中持续具有相关性的原因。

title: Paths to the Rainforests: Ancestral Beliefs and Fertility in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 通往雨林之路：撒哈拉以南非洲的祖先信仰与生育率
title_primary: 通往雨林之路：撒哈拉以南非洲的祖先信仰与生育率

authors: Pablo Alvarez-Aragon
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充性解释：祖先能够影响现世生活，并寻求其血脉延续，后代可能成为祖先转世之身。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为植根于精神责任的道德与集体义务，旨在确保家族血脉的存续。通过运用一手数据、新颖的民族志资料以及历史与当代调查，本文证实了祖先信仰与生育率之间在跨时期、跨情境中均存在显著且数量级较大的正向关联。将子女视为家族公共品的简单模型，能够合理解释数据中呈现的规律：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹间因子女延续同一家族血脉而出现特定形式的搭便车行为。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在被标准外部干预措施所忽视的道德基础之上。

title: Costly regulation, minimal results: The EU’s deforestation regulation effect on global soy trade
title_zh: 高成本监管，低效结果：欧盟毁林法规对全球大豆贸易的影响
title_primary: 高成本监管，低效结果：欧盟毁林法规对全球大豆贸易的影响
title_secondary: Costly regulation, minimal results: The EU’s deforestation regulation effect on global soy trade
authors: Manoj Sharma, Nelson B Villoria
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) seeks to reduce deforestation by restricting market access to deforestation-embodied soy products in the EU market. The main concern is that such restrictions could shift the soy trade to unregulated non-EU markets. To shed light on this issue, we employ a gravity model, treating the EUDR compliance costs as additional trade costs for exports to the EU. We find that stricter compliance costs reallocate soy exports from South America toward non-EU markets, mainly China, divert the EU imports toward North America, and increase the prices of soy faced by EU soy users. Under the counterfactual scenario in which South America does not comply with the regulation, EU consumers face even larger price increases, while South American countries experience minimal terms-of-trade losses. Our analysis suggests that trade reallocation to an unregulated market could potentially dilute the impact of the EUDR, making it less effective in directly reducing deforestation linked to soy production.
abstract_zh: 欧盟毁林法规（EUDR）旨在通过限制含有毁林成分的大豆产品进入欧盟市场来减少森林砍伐。主要担忧在于此类限制可能导致大豆贸易转向不受监管的非欧盟市场。为阐明这一问题，我们采用引力模型，将EUDR合规成本视为对欧盟出口的额外贸易成本。研究发现：更严格的合规成本促使南美大豆出口向非欧盟市场（主要是中国）转移，导致欧盟进口转向北美市场，并推高欧盟大豆用户面临的价格。在反事实情景中，若南美不遵守该法规，欧盟消费者将面临更大的价格上涨，而南美国家仅遭受微小的贸易条件损失。我们的分析表明，贸易向未受监管市场的重新配置可能削弱EUDR的效果，使其在直接减少与大豆生产相关的毁林方面效力降低。

title: Environmental regulation and indirect innovation effects along supply chain: Evidence from China's water pollution prevention and control action plan
title_zh: 环境规制与供应链上的间接创新效应：来自中国水污染防治行动计划的证据
title_primary: 环境规制与供应链上的间接创新效应：来自中国水污染防治行动计划的证据
title_secondary: Environmental regulation and indirect innovation effects along supply chain: Evidence from China's water pollution prevention and control action plan
authors: Kerui Du, Kaixi He, Xin Yao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Conventional wisdom holds that environmental regulation directly spurs innovation within polluting firms, enabling them to comply with standards while boosting competitiveness. Using China's Water Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan as a quasi-experiment, we ask instead whether regulation primarily induces innovation in regulated firms or in their upstream suppliers. We find no statistically significant increase in water-related green patenting among regulated polluters, but a pronounced rise among their upstream suppliers. This upstream response is stronger in regions with higher wastewater discharge intensity, greater innovation capacity, and stronger intellectual property protection, and is concentrated among competitive, non-state-owned, and larger firms. Innovation mainly targets pollution control rather than preventive technologies. Regulated firms comply chiefly by purchasing external abatement solutions, rather than through knowledge spillovers that enhance their own inventive activity. These findings reveal a demand-driven supply-chain channel through which environmental regulation reshapes the locus and direction of green innovation by creating markets for environmental technologies.
abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，环境规制直接刺激污染企业内部的创新，使其在达标的同时提升竞争力。本文以中国《水污染防治行动计划》为准自然实验，转而探讨规制主要诱发被规制企业还是其上游供应商的创新。研究发现，在被规制的污染企业中，水相关绿色专利并无统计上显著的增加，但其上游供应商的绿色专利则显著上升。这种上游响应在废水排放强度更高、创新能力更强及知识产权保护更完善的地区更为突出，且集中于竞争性强、非国有及规模较大的企业。创新主要聚焦于污染治理技术，而非预防性技术。被规制企业主要通过购买外部治理方案来合规，而非借助知识溢出增强自身的发明活动。这些发现揭示了一条需求驱动的供应链渠道，环境规制通过创造环境技术市场，重塑了绿色创新的发生位置与方向。

title: The Meta Pricing Efficiency of Producer Cooperatives Under Hedonic Product Attributes: The Case of German Wine

authors: Rebecca Hansen, Sebastian Hess
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT High internal coordination costs may put cooperatives at a disadvantage in the production and marketing of agri‐food products with hedonic quality attributes. The efficiency of cooperatives and non‐cooperatives is therefore compared with respect to their ability to place wines on the market at prices that reflect their measurable quality attributes. The results of a stochastic metafrontier panel of 1240 wine prices from two German wine guides suggest that consumers should purchase wine from cooperatives if they are seeking a favourable relation between market prices and wine quality. In turn, members of wine cooperatives should ask themselves why non‐cooperatives are typically better at achieving higher prices for the respective quality of their wines and how they can close the price gap with non‐cooperative wineries.
abstract_zh: 摘要 高昂的内部协调成本可能使合作社在生产和销售具有享乐性质量属性的农产品时处于劣势。因此，本文比较了合作社与非合作社在将葡萄酒以反映其可测量质量属性的价格投放市场方面的效率。基于来自两本德国葡萄酒指南的1240个葡萄酒价格随机元前沿面板数据，结果表明，如果消费者寻求市场价格与葡萄酒质量之间的有利关系，应从合作社购买葡萄酒。反过来，葡萄酒合作社的成员应反思为何非合作社通常更能为其相应质量的葡萄酒获得更高价格，以及如何缩小与非合作社酒庄之间的价格差距。

authors: MATHIAS KLEIN, LUDGER LINNEMANN
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The paper presents empirical evidence on the international effects of U.S. fiscal policy from structural vector autoregressions identified through external instruments in a panel setting for the G7 countries. An exogenous increase in U.S. government spending is estimated to produce sizable positive responses of output and consumption in the rest of the G7 countries, both about half as large as their domestic U.S. counterparts, while strongly depreciating the U.S. terms of trade and lowering the U.S. trade balance and short‐run real interest rates. Moreover, fiscal shocks are estimated to have a strongly positive impact on hourly labor productivity in the private sector. We solve a two‐country New Keynesian model in closed form and show that a low cost elasticity of varying technology utilization can simultaneously explain the positive productivity, consumption, and international spillover effects as well as the real depreciation resulting from expansionary U.S. government spending shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文通过结构向量自回归模型，利用外部工具变量在七国集团小组设定中进行识别，提供了美国财政政策国际影响的实证证据。研究发现，美国政府支出的外生增加，对七国集团其他国家的产出和消费产生了显著的正向效应，其规模约为美国国内效应的一半，同时导致美国贸易条件大幅贬值，贸易余额下降，短期实际利率走低。此外，财政冲击对私人部门每小时劳动生产率具有强烈的正向影响。我们以闭式解形式求解了一个两国新凯恩斯模型，并证明较低的技术利用率成本弹性能够同时解释扩张性美国政府支出冲击所带来的正向生产率、消费及国际溢出效应，以及实际汇率贬值现象。

title: Open Rule Legislative Bargaining

authors: Volker Britz, Hans Gersbach
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The seminal paper by Baron and Ferejohn (1989) leaves significant gaps in our understanding of open rule bargaining. We aim to fill these gaps by providing a fresh analysis of open rule bargaining. Our approach relies on an appealing class of stationary equilibria. In this class, we show that delays tend to be longer and allocations tend to be less egalitarian than originally predicted by Baron and Ferejohn. Our results shed new light on the efficiency and fairness implications of using an open vs. closed rule in legislatures and of bargaining processes in general.
abstract_zh: Baron与Ferejohn（1989）的开创性论文在开放规则谈判领域留下了显著的研究空白。本文旨在通过提供对开放规则谈判的全新分析来填补这些空白。我们的研究方法依赖于一类具有吸引力的稳态均衡。在该均衡类别中，我们证明谈判延迟往往比Baron与Ferejohn最初预测的更久，而资源分配则更不平均。这一发现为立法机构中开放规则与封闭规则的使用效率及公平性影响，以及更广泛的谈判过程提供了全新视角。

title: Circular Bioeconomy for Sustainable Agriculture and Food Systems: An Editorial Introduction
title_zh: 循环生物经济促进可持续农业与食品系统：编辑导言
title_primary: 循环生物经济促进可持续农业与食品系统：编辑导言
title_secondary: Circular Bioeconomy for Sustainable Agriculture and Food Systems: An Editorial Introduction
authors: Wanglin Ma, Johannes Sauer, Dil Bahadur Rahut, Tetsushi Sonobe
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This special issue advances a multi‐scalar, empirically grounded understanding of circular bioeconomy transitions in agriculture and food systems by integrating systems‐level analyses with farm‐ and household‐level evidence from diverse developing and emerging economies. The key findings include (1) circular bioeconomy research in agrifood systems in Australia and New Zealand is rapidly expanding but highly fragmented, dominated by technical perspectives with inconsistent definitions and limited social science engagement, with Australia emphasising technological recycling and New Zealand focussing more on ecological and social redesign; (2) there is a substantial untapped potential to integrate land, marine, forest and water resources into Indonesia's circular bioeconomy through converting diverse biomass residues into bio‐based products, but scaling is constrained by limited technical capacity, infrastructure gaps, policy fragmentation and high investment costs; (3) there exists pronounced heterogeneity in circular bioeconomy readiness, with most southeast Asian countries facing high agrifood emissions and low material‐use efficiency, while performance advantages in innovation and efficiency are concentrated in a few economies; (4) technical skill gaps and awareness deficits are the primary, system‐shaping constraints on crop‐residue bioenergy adoption, with spillover effects that hinder infrastructure, markets and coordination in the circular bioeconomy; (5) adoption of integrated crop–livestock systems increases bio‐fertiliser use, reduces chemical fertiliser expenditure among younger farmers and raises farm revenue without increasing costs, demonstrating the economic and environmental viability of farm‐level circular bioeconomy practices; and (6) composting spent mushroom substrate delivers the highest productivity gains compared with on‐farm deposition and distant dumping, with farmers' management choices shaped by education, extension access, infrastructure quality and mobility. These findings highlight that policies should standardise circular bioeconomy definitions and metrics, invest in farmer knowledge and extension as first‐order enablers and coordinate cross‐sector infrastructure and governance to unlock scale.
abstract_zh: 本期特刊通过将系统层面的分析与来自多个发展中及新兴经济体的农场和家庭层面证据相结合，推进了对农业和食品系统中循环生物经济转型的多尺度、经验性理解。主要发现包括：（1）澳大利亚和新西兰农业食品系统中的循环生物经济研究正在迅速扩展，但高度碎片化，以技术视角为主导，定义不一致，社会科学参与有限，其中澳大利亚强调技术回收，而新西兰更侧重于生态和社会重新设计；（2）印度尼西亚在将土地、海洋、森林和水资源整合到循环生物经济方面存在巨大的未开发潜力，可通过将多种生物质残留物转化为生物基产品实现，但规模化受到技术能力有限、基础设施缺口、政策碎片化和高投资成本的制约；（3）循环生物经济准备程度存在显著异质性，大多数东南亚国家面临高农业食品排放和低物质利用效率，而创新和效率方面的绩效优势集中在少数经济体；（4）技术技能缺口和认知不足是作物残留物生物能源采用的主要系统性制约因素，其溢出效应阻碍了循环生物经济中的基础设施、市场和协调；（5）采用作物—牲畜综合系统可增加生物肥料使用，降低年轻农户的化肥支出，并在不增加成本的情况下提高农场收入，证明了农场层面循环生物经济实践的经济和环境可行性；（6）与农场就地堆放和远距离倾倒相比，堆肥废弃蘑菇基质可带来最高的生产力提升，而农户的管理选择受教育程度、推广服务获取、基础设施质量和流动性影响。这些发现强调，政策应标准化循环生物经济的定义和指标，将农户知识和推广投资作为首要推动因素，并协调跨部门基础设施和治理以释放规模化潜力。

title: 大国科技竞争下的前沿技术路线布局与研发资助策略

abstract: 随着我国工业体系在全球价值链上的渐进升级，我国企业需直面与发达国家在关键核心技术研发领域的排他性竞争，并抢占前沿技术领域的话语主导权。本文构建了一个考虑外国企业可能率先实现技术突破的非对称动态研发竞赛模型，理论分析了我国企业的技术路线与研发投入选择，以及相应的政府最优技术路线布局与研发投入资助策略。研究发现，在单一技术路线下，政府应根据外部时间压力动态调整资助策略：压力较小时，遵循“研发效率优先”...

title: Market feedback: Evidence from the horse’s mouth
title_zh: 市场反馈：来自马嘴的证据
title_primary: 市场反馈：来自马嘴的证据
title_secondary: Market feedback: Evidence from the horse’s mouth
authors: Itay Goldstein, Bibo Liu, Liyan Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We surveyed all Chinese public firms in 2019 and 2022 to examine the real effects of financial markets. Over 90% of firms say they actively monitor the stock market, and the most common reasons they provide are that they learn new information from the price and that they depend on the price for financing. Focusing on the learning channel, we examine how the responses relate to firm characteristics and actions. Firms that indicate learning have characteristics that suggest greater benefit from market information. They also exhibit higher investment-to-price sensitivity. We provide results on what dimensions of information firms learn about.
abstract_zh: 我们于2019年和2022年调查了所有中国上市公司，以考察金融市场的实际效应。超过90%的企业表示积极关注股票市场，其最常提及的原因是，它们从价格中获取新信息，并依赖价格进行融资。聚焦于学习渠道，我们考察了这些回应如何与企业特征及行为相关联。表明存在学习行为的企业，其特征显示出从市场信息中获益更大。它们还表现出更高的投资-价格敏感性。我们提供了关于企业学习信息维度的结果。

title: Between famine and freedom: Food prices during the Indonesian War of Independence, 1945–9
title_zh: 饥荒与自由之间：印度尼西亚独立战争时期的食品价格（1945-1949）
title_primary: 饥荒与自由之间：印度尼西亚独立战争时期的食品价格（1945-1949）
title_secondary: Between famine and freedom: Food prices during the Indonesian War of Independence, 1945–9
authors: Ingrid de Zwarte, Helmi Moret, Pim de Zwart
official: 官方在线 2026-01-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates how the Indonesian War of Independence (1945‒9) influenced staple food prices, and how fluctuations in those prices, in turn, shaped the trajectory and dynamics of the conflict. We compiled a dataset comprising more than 8600 prices for staple foods covering the entire Indonesian archipelago from 1939‒49, allowing us to estimate the effects of wartime conditions and the main Dutch military campaigns on food prices. We find that wartime price peaks were much more severe and prolonged than studies previously assumed, both in and outside Java. We show that the first large military operation, Operation Product, was partly motivated by high rice prices and demonstrate that these prices were significantly reduced across Java and Sumatra after the end of the military campaign. We then use a second dataset on wartime wages to estimate nutritional standards. These combined data suggest a very low nutritional status of urban unskilled wage labourers – often below the family subsistence level – in 1946 and the first half of 1947. Our results point to broader entitlement failures driven by weak market connectivity amidst military and economic warfare.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了印度尼西亚独立战争（1945-1949年）如何影响主食价格，以及这些价格的波动又如何反过来塑造了冲突的轨迹与动态。我们编制了一个包含1939年至1949年间覆盖整个印尼群岛的8600多个主食价格的数据集，从而能够估算战时条件及荷兰主要军事行动对食品价格的影响。研究发现，战时价格峰值比以往研究假设的更为严重且持续时间更长，无论是在爪哇岛内外均是如此。我们表明，第一次大规模军事行动——“产品行动”——部分是由大米价格高涨所驱动，并证明在军事行动结束后，爪哇和苏门答腊的大米价格显著下降。随后，我们利用第二个关于战时工资的数据集来估算营养标准。这些综合数据表明，1946年至1947年上半年，城市非技术工人的营养状况极低——往往低于家庭基本生活水平。我们的研究结果指向了在军事与经济战争背景下，市场连通性薄弱所导致的更广泛的应享权利失败。

title: Sources of Consumer Information
title_zh: 消费者信息来源
title_primary: 消费者信息来源
title_secondary: Sources of Consumer Information
authors: Frédéric Koessler, Régis Renault, Heiko Karle, Marcel Preuss, Markus Reisinger 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A buyer can learn about a product through search or seller-disclosed information. We examine how lower search costs or better seller disclosure affects this interaction. Whereas a drop in search costs improves consumer surplus and decreases profit when the seller can resort to an optimal disclosure strategy, its impact is ambiguous if the seller is unable to provide information. When it is unlikely that the buyer's valuation is below marginal cost, the buyer does not benefit from optimal information disclosure if search costs are high. With such high search costs and no disclosure both parties can be better off than with lower search costs and optimal information disclosure. The seller then adopts a mass market strategy where she posts a low enough price so the buyer always purchases the product without search. By contrast, if it is sufficiently likely that the buyer's valuation is below marginal cost, then the buyer can benefit from sophisticated information disclosure for relatively low search costs. The corresponding outcome is better for both parties than an environment with higher search costs and no information disclosure. The optimal seller strategy targets a niche of high-valuation buyers and prevents wasteful search by buyers with low valuations.
abstract_zh: 买方可通过搜索或卖方披露的信息了解产品。我们考察了搜索成本降低或卖方信息披露改善如何影响这一互动过程。当卖方能够采用最优信息披露策略时，搜索成本下降会提升消费者剩余并降低利润；但若卖方无法提供信息，其影响则具有不确定性。当买方估值低于边际成本的可能性较小时，若搜索成本较高，买方无法从最优信息披露中获益。在此高搜索成本且无信息披露的情况下，双方境况可能优于低搜索成本配合最优信息披露的情形——此时卖方采取大众市场策略，设定足够低的价格使买方无需搜索即可直接购买产品。相反，若买方估值低于边际成本的可能性足够大，则在相对较低的搜索成本下，买方可从精细化信息披露中获益。相较于高搜索成本且无信息披露的环境，该情形下的结果对双方更为有利。此时卖方的最优策略是瞄准高估值买方群体，同时避免低估值买方进行无效搜索。

title: Implicit land taxes and their effect on the real economy
title_zh: 隐性土地税及其对实体经济的影响
title_primary: 隐性土地税及其对实体经济的影响
title_secondary: Implicit land taxes and their effect on the real economy
authors: Daniel Murphy, Nathan Seegert
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2023-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land taxes are widely viewed as an efficient source of public revenue, yet explicit land taxation is rarely implemented. We study a closely related but largely overlooked object: implicit land taxes that arise within standard property tax systems when tax assessments place different relative weights on land and structures than market valuations do. Using parcel-level data on assessed values and transaction prices from U.S. counties, we estimate these implicit land taxes by comparing assessor and market hedonic valuations. We find substantial dispersion in implicit land taxes across and within metropolitan areas. Counties with higher implicit land taxes experience faster growth in population density, business establishments, earnings, and demographic diversity. These patterns are consistent with theoretical predictions that taxing land more heavily than structures encourages denser and more productive development.
abstract_zh: 土地税被广泛视为一种高效的公共收入来源，但明确征收土地税的做法却鲜有实施。我们研究了一个密切相关但长期被忽视的对象：当房产税评估体系对土地和建筑物的相对权重与市场估值存在差异时，标准财产税制度中产生的隐性土地税。利用美国各县的地块级评估价值与交易价格数据，我们通过比较评估师与市场的特征价格估值来估算这些隐性土地税。研究发现，大都市区内部及之间均存在显著的隐性土地税差异。隐性土地税较高的县，其人口密度、商业机构数量、收入水平及人口多样性均呈现更快增长。这些现象与理论预测一致：对土地课以重于建筑物的税负，将促进更密集、更高效率的开发模式。

title: Three-Stage TSARs, Interdependent Values, and Biodiversity Production on Private Lands
title_zh: 三阶段TSAR、相互依赖价值与私有土地上的生物多样性生产

authors: Agee, M. D., Crocker, T. D.
official: 官方在线 2021-12-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a static three-stage incentive-compatible, budget-balanced, execution-contingent scheme for a regulator to allocate biodiversity protection responsibilities across a landscape mosaic having multiple value-interdependent owners. The scheme motivates owners to truthfully report their opportunity costs of protection to the regulator and to comply with their assigned habitat protection responsibilities. JEL classification: C62D7Q21Q57 Keywords: Tradable set-aside requirementsefficiencyinterdependent valuationsmechanism designbiodiversity
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种静态三阶段激励相容、预算平衡且执行依存的方案，供监管机构在具有多个价值相互依存的土地所有者的景观镶嵌体中分配生物多样性保护责任。该方案激励所有者向监管机构如实报告其保护的机会成本，并遵守其被分配的生境保护责任。JEL分类：C62D7Q21Q57 关键词：可交易预留要求；效率；相互依存的估值；机制设计；生物多样性
